shelf_entry.summary: Grounded lore answers for any generator or agent: one script tag gives SysAiMayaLoreOracle.client(); hidden iframe + postMessage to Maya's Lore Oracle (perchance.org/sys-ai-maya-lore-oracle); ask/search/status/verify/recent/manifest; every answer cited (pack chunk or chatlog row), refuses under the 0.25 floor; url() builds the no-click #agent&op= link; pack and token stay in the oracle origin; errors as values.

interface.name: SysAiMayaLoreOracle.client

inputs.name: opts
inputs.description: base, frameUrl, target+targetOrigin, timeoutMs (20000), longTimeoutMs (120000), readyMs (45000). All optional; defaults point at perchance.org/sys-ai-maya-lore-oracle.

output.description: Client object: open, call, manifest, status, ask, search, verify, recent, url, proof, log, close.

side_effects: Mounts one hidden 1x1 iframe (data-chip=SYS.AI.MAYA.PERCHANCE) on first call and adds a window message listener; close() removes both. Network only inside the oracle frame. No host storage writes.

external_dependencies: Maya's Lore Oracle page perchance.org/sys-ai-maya-lore-oracle (SYS.AI.MAYA.PERCHANCE, lane 016) reachable.
Erato .jsonl.gz pack attached once per browser on the oracle page; Erato chatlog token pasted once there for the chatlog tier.
requirements.host_setup: Host adds <script src="https://user.uploads.dev/file/276cf65bed25d99b13ec8f4a545edf3e.js"></script> and calls SysAiMayaLoreOracle.client(). Agents with no DOM use client().url(op,args) or the link perchance.org/sys-ai-maya-lore-oracle#agent&op=ask&q=... directly. Proven 2026-11-13 live on perchance.org/sys-ai-maya-lore-oracle-chip-test and in-preview inside unsaved copies of mythos-cont, commpack-sia, repo-depot, residue clean.
